### Outcome
Completed the approved public 2x retention and finalization implementation under the task contract. Legacy retention interfaces (`automation_objectives`, `automation_offers`, `automation_policy_revision`) remain intact, additive v3 capacities and offers are implemented, scoped finalization advance and promotion are delivered with durable JSON receipts, the versioned v3 contract is frozen, and full test suites pass.

### Evidence
- **Exact v3 Capacity Arithmetic**:
  - Legacy baseline: 7,027 objectives, 105,644 primary slots.
  - Expansion objectives: 516 added objectives (504 atomic Overworld biomes across 56 biomes × 3 borders × 3 modes, 9 basement igloo lists across 3 borders × 3 modes, 3 treasure bastion lists across 3 modes).
  - Primary target: [`automation_primary_objectives_v3()`](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/93ba15b1adf2/workspace/src/seed_search/catalog/retention.py#L143-L163) yields exactly 7,543 objectives and 115,964 primary slots.
  - Effective 2x capacity: [`automation_objectives_v3()`](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/93ba15b1adf2/workspace/src/seed_search/catalog/retention.py#L166-L174) yields exactly 7,543 objectives and 231,928 effective slots (each objective has `effective_k = 2 * primary_k`).
- **Deterministic Unique-World Offers & Gating**:
  - [`automation_offers_v3()`](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/93ba15b1adf2/workspace/src/seed_search/catalog/retention.py#L254-L445) deduplicates candidates per world per objective.
  - Nearest-witness rank formatted as `[d2, world_id, anchor_x, anchor_z, witness_x, witness_y, witness_z]` with witness within the selected border envelope.
  - Gated features offer nothing under default settings; injectable fixture registries toggle feature availability without module pollution.
  - Spawn mode requires an actual compatible spawn anchor (`world_spawn_estimated` or `world_spawn_observed`) with no synthetic Origin fallback.
  - Legacy offers reuse v1 summaries with v2 anchor digest tie-breakers.
- **Finalization & Scoped Verification**:
  - [`advance_finalization()`](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/93ba15b1adf2/workspace/src/seed_search/catalog/finalization.py#L76-L195) advances candidates over frozen rank order.
  - Scoped evidence identity binds `seed`, `anchor`, `border`, `dimension`, `profile`, `build_id`, and `requirements`.
  - Passing candidates advance to target K; passing reserves are promoted when primary candidates fail.
  - Failures are strictly scoped to the specific objective/evidence identity and do not blacklist the seed globally.
  - Inconclusive, error, or unverified states remain pending without fabricating target completion.
  - Bounded verification budgets stop execution gracefully and report actual verified counts.
  - Receipts are reused by evidence identity across evaluations.
  - Progress persistence uses atomic file replacement with no second database or background orchestrator.
